title: Baked Turkey Meatballs in Marinara Sauce
description: Lean ground turkey meatballs with herbs and parmesan, simmered in tomato sauce.
steps: Mix the turkey with breadcrumbs, parmesan, egg, garlic and herbs, then form 16 meatballs.
Brown in a skillet, then transfer to a baking dish.
Pour over the marinara sauce and bake at 200C for 15 minutes until cooked through.
notes: Panko keeps the meatballs light rather than dense — freeze extras in the sauce for a fast future dinner.
